trust_decision.summary: dbi_profile() treats the result of dbih_inner() on DBIc_MY_H(imp_dbh) as an RV and derefs it; during outer-handle DESTROY DBIc_MY_H holds the raw inner HV, so dbih_inner returns the HV itself and SvRV() yields HvARRAY used as an HV (type confusion). The decision is 'is this SV an RV or a raw HV', made in the {attr} Path branch of dbi_profile.

landing_point.why: Summary names dbi_profile, DESTROY and {attr} Path element; the only {attr} handling in dbi_profile is the dbh_inner_hv cache block. NOTE: at the pinned commit this line already contains the fix.

fix_sites.entry_point: any profiled DBI method call (dispatch at DBI.xs:4066-4086, DESTROY via DBI.xs:5031) or the public DBI::dbi_profile() XS sub (DBI.xs:4852-4865) with a Profile Path containing '{Attr}'

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; other dbih_inner() callers either already handle the raw-HV case (DBI.xs:1610, DBI.xs:5650-5651) or only receive RVs (DBI.xs:2867 is passed the dispatch/XS 'h' after validation at DBI.xs:4863).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: DESTROY of a dbh must still be profiled (counted exactly once) under a {Username} path; an over-broad fix that just bails out when DBIc_MY_H is the inner HV would drop the DESTROY node; also outer-hash fallback for tied attrs like AutoCommit must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: DBIc_MY_H pointing to outer tied HV (normal: dbih_inner returns RV)
DBIc_MY_H pointing to raw inner HV (during outer DESTROY: dbih_inner returns the HV itself)

O7_producer.where: State producer is the outer-DESTROY path that rewrites DBIc_MY_H to the inner HV (DBI.xs:3270-3271), a handler not a schema/serializer; the fixed check does not call it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: h_hv = (HV*)SvRV(dbih_inner(h, ...)) at the top of dbi_profile could be fed DBIc_MY_H-derived raw HV by a planted caller
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same idiom, same function; a maintainer adding a profiling call from DESTROY/clearcom passing (SV*)DBIc_MY_H would hit it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dbih_dumpcom uses dbih_inner on DBIc_MY_H; removing the SvROK guard at 1610 would plant the same confusion
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Guard is a single line and the idiom SvRV(inner) is used immediately after.

O9_family: memory-safety: type confusion (CWE-843) RV vs raw HV in XS

O10_build.toolchain: perl, ExtUtils::MakeMaker, C compiler (perl Makefile.PL && make && make test)
O10_build.project_tests: t/40profile.t (includes the CVE regression block at t/40profile.t:492-503)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Return &PL_sv_undef when DBIc_MY_H is not tied / during DESTROY, which stops the crash but drops DESTROY profiling.
